'''Richie Undercover Nightmare''' is a [[Light]] deck by Richie, published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls100.htm Undercover Nightmare], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001029173647/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls100.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
